rows: Contoso Ltd: pay each invoice within 45 days of receipt
Contoso Ltd must pay each undisputed monthly invoice within 45 days after receipt; fees under SOW No. 1 are $45,000 per month ($540,000 per year), invoiced monthly in arrears.
Customer shall pay each undisputed invoice within forty-five (45) days after receipt.
Contoso Ltd receives each monthly invoice
Maintain 99.5% monthly portal availability for Contoso Ltd
Northwind must ensure the Service Portal achieves at least 99.5% Availability in each calendar month, excluding Scheduled Maintenance; a miss requires a service credit under Section 4.2.
Service Provider shall ensure that the Service Portal achieves Availability of at least 99.5% in each calendar month.
Issue Contoso Ltd service credit after an availability miss

If monthly Availability falls below 99.5%, Northwind must credit Contoso Ltd 5% of the monthly Fees for each full or partial percentage point below 99.5% (capped at 25% of monthly Fees), applied against the next invoice.

If Availability in any calendar month falls below 99.5%, Service Provider shall issue Customer a service credit equal to five percent (5%) of the monthly Fees for each full percentage point (or portion of a percentage point) by which Availability falls below 99.5%, up to a maximum of twenty-five percent (25%) of the monthly Fees, applied against the next invoice.
Deliver quarterly service-level report to Contoso Ltd (15 days)
Northwind must deliver Contoso Ltd a written service-level report showing Availability, incident counts and service credits issued within 15 days after the end of each calendar quarter.

Service Provider shall deliver to Customer a written service-level report for each calendar quarter, showing Availability, incident counts and service credits issued, within fifteen (15) days after the end of such calendar quarter.
Protect Contoso Ltd confidential information (term + 3 years)

Each party must hold the other's Confidential Information in confidence, use it only to perform or receive the Services, and disclose it only to need-to-know staff and contractors bound by equally protective written terms, during the Term and for 3 years after it ends.

Each Party shall hold the other Party's Confidential Information in confidence, use it only to perform or receive the Services, and disclose it only to its employees and contractors who need to know it and are bound by written confidentiality obligations at least as protective as this Article 5.
Cooperate with Contoso Ltd audit (30 days' notice)

On at least 30 days' written notice, Contoso Ltd or its independent auditor may audit Northwind's records on the Services and Fees at most once per 12 months, and Northwind must cooperate and give reasonable access to records, systems and personnel during business hours. Contoso Ltd bears the audit cost.

Upon not less than thirty (30) days' prior written notice, Customer or its independent auditor may audit Service Provider's records relating to the Services and the Fees, no more than once in any twelve (12) month period. Service Provider shall cooperate with any such audit and provide reasonable access to relevant records, systems and personnel during normal business hours.
Contoso Ltd gives written audit notice
Deliver certificate of insurance to Contoso Ltd by December 15

Northwind must maintain commercial general liability insurance of at least $2,000,000 per occurrence and technology E&O insurance of at least $5,000,000 per claim during the Term, and deliver Contoso Ltd a certificate of insurance on or before December 15 each year.

During the Term, Service Provider shall maintain commercial general liability insurance with limits of not less than $2,000,000 per occurrence and technology errors and omissions insurance with limits of not less than $5,000,000 per claim. Service Provider shall deliver to Customer a certificate of insurance evidencing the coverage required by this Section 7.1 on or before December 15 of each calendar year during the Term.
Send non-renewal notice to Contoso Ltd (90 days)
Either party may stop the MSA from auto-renewing for another 1-year term by written notice of non-renewal at least 90 days before the end of the current term, which ends March 31, 2027.
Either Party may elect not to renew this Agreement by giving the other Party written notice of non-renewal at least ninety (90) days before the end of the then-current Term.
Send non-renewal notice to Contoso Ltd (120 days)

Either party may stop the MSA from auto-renewing for another 1-year term by written notice of non-renewal at least 120 days before the end of the current term; for the term ending March 31, 2027, notice is due on or before December 1, 2026.

Either Party may elect not to renew this Agreement by giving the other Party written notice of non-renewal at least one hundred twenty (120) days before the end of the then-current Term." For clarity, for the Renewal Term ending March 31, 2027, notice of non-renewal must be given on or before December 1, 2026.
Deliver quarterly service-level report to Contoso Ltd (10 days)

Northwind must deliver Contoso Ltd a written service-level report showing Availability, incident counts and service credits issued within 10 days after the end of each calendar quarter, starting with the quarter ended September 30, 2026.

Service Provider shall deliver to Customer a written service-level report for each calendar quarter, showing Availability, incident counts and service credits issued, within ten (10) days after the end of such calendar quarter.
Send Contoso Ltd fee-increase notice by January 31 (60 days)

Northwind may raise the Fees for each Renewal Term starting on or after April 1, 2027 by up to 4% over the prior term only if it gives Contoso Ltd written notice at least 60 days before that Renewal Term starts (by January 31, 2027 for the term starting April 1, 2027).

For each Renewal Term beginning on or after April 1, 2027, Service Provider may increase the Fees by up to four percent (4%) over the Fees in effect for the preceding Term, provided that Service Provider gives Customer written notice of the increase at least sixty (60) days before the start of that Renewal Term.
Due date matches Exhibit A (illustrative): latest notice date January 31, 2027.
Deliver updated BCP/DR plan to Contoso Ltd (60 days)

Northwind must deliver Contoso Ltd an updated business continuity and disaster recovery plan for the Services, including recovery time and recovery point objectives for the Service Portal, within 60 days after the September 1, 2026 Amendment Effective Date (by October 31, 2026).

Within sixty (60) days after the Amendment Effective Date, Service Provider shall deliver to Customer an updated business continuity and disaster recovery plan for the Services, including recovery time and recovery point objectives for the Service Portal.
Pay Fabrikam Inc monthly hosting fee (30 days after invoice)

Northwind must pay the $38,500 Monthly Fee, invoiced in advance on the 1st of each month, within 30 days after the invoice date; undisputed amounts unpaid 15 days after the due date bear interest at the lesser of 1% per month and the legal maximum. Through March 31, 2027.
Provider shall invoice the Monthly Fees in advance on the first day of each calendar month. Customer shall pay each invoice within thirty (30) days after the invoice date.
Fabrikam Inc: give 60 days' notice of any fee increase (max 5%)

Fabrikam Inc may raise the Monthly Fees at most once in any 12 months and by no more than 5%, and only on at least 60 days' prior written notice; an increase made without that notice is void. Through March 31, 2027.

Provider may increase the Monthly Fees no more than once in any twelve (12) month period, and no single increase may exceed five percent (5%) of the Monthly Fees then in effect. Provider shall give Customer at least sixty (60) days' prior written notice of any increase, and any increase made without such notice is void.
Fabrikam Inc proposes a Monthly Fee increase

Fabrikam Inc must keep the Hosting Services at a Monthly Uptime Percentage of at least 99.9% each calendar month; misses earn service credits if claimed (Section 4.3), and uptime below 99.0% in any 3 months of a rolling 6 lets Northwind terminate. Through March 31, 2027.
Provider shall make the Hosting Services available with a Monthly Uptime Percentage of at least 99.9% in each calendar month.
Claim Fabrikam Inc service credit within 30 days after month end

After any month with Monthly Uptime below 99.9%, Northwind must submit a written claim to Fabrikam Inc within 30 days after that month ends or lose the credit (10% of that month's Monthly Fees, or 25% if uptime is below 99.0%). Approved credits apply to the next invoice. Through March 31, 2027.

To receive a Service Credit, Customer must submit a written claim to Provider within thirty (30) days after the end of the calendar month in which the Downtime occurred. Customer's failure to submit a claim within that period waives Customer's right to a Service Credit for that month.
A calendar month with Monthly Uptime Percentage below 99.9%
Request Fabrikam Inc transition assistance by January 30, 2027

To get up to 90 days of transition assistance at Fabrikam Inc's then-current professional services rates, Northwind must request it by written notice at least 60 days before the March 31, 2027 Expiration Date (by January 30, 2027). Through March 31, 2027.

If Customer requests transition assistance by written notice delivered at least sixty (60) days before the Expiration Date, Provider shall provide up to ninety (90) days of transition assistance at its then-current professional services rates to support the migration of Customer Data and workloads to Customer or its designated successor provider.
Decide on Fabrikam Inc renewal before March 31, 2027 expiry
The agreement expires on March 31, 2027 and does not renew automatically; any renewal or extension must be agreed in writing and signed by both parties before then. Through March 31, 2027.
This Agreement does not renew automatically. This Agreement may be renewed or extended only by a written agreement signed by both Parties before the Expiration Date.
Observe Tailspin Toys exclusivity and non-compete in Territory

During the Term, Tailspin Toys must not appoint any other distributor of the Products in Washington, Oregon, Idaho or Montana, and Northwind must not market or sell Competing Products (other makers' RC aircraft, drones or hobby flight kits) there. Through June 30, 2029.
During the Term, Supplier shall not appoint any other distributor of the Products in the Territory, and Distributor shall not market or sell any Competing Products in the Territory.
Purchase $750,000 minimum from Tailspin Toys by June 30

Northwind must buy Products with an aggregate net purchase price of at least $750,000 in each Contract Year (July 1 to June 30); after a shortfall, Tailspin Toys may make the appointment non-exclusive by notice within 60 days after that Contract Year ends. Through June 30, 2029.
Distributor shall purchase Products having an aggregate net purchase price of not less than $750,000 during each Contract Year (the "Minimum Commitment").
Send Tailspin Toys quarterly sales and inventory report (20 days)

Within 20 days after the end of each calendar quarter, Northwind must deliver Tailspin Toys a written report of Net Sales by Product and by state for the quarter and Products on hand at quarter end. Through June 30, 2029.

Within twenty (20) days after the end of each calendar quarter, Distributor shall deliver to Supplier a written report showing Net Sales by Product and by state for that quarter and Distributor's inventory of Products on hand at the end of that quarter.
Submit initial marketing plan to Tailspin Toys (90 days)

Within 90 days after the July 1, 2026 Effective Date (by September 29, 2026), Northwind must submit to Tailspin Toys for approval an initial marketing plan for the Products in the Territory covering the first 18 months of the Term. Through June 30, 2029.

Within ninety (90) days after the Effective Date, Distributor shall submit to Supplier for approval an initial marketing plan for the Products in the Territory covering the first eighteen (18) months of the Term.
Pay Tailspin Toys 2% marketing fund contribution by January 31

Northwind must contribute 2% of its Net Sales of Products for each calendar year to Tailspin Toys' cooperative marketing development fund, payable on or before January 31 of the following year. Through June 30, 2029.

Distributor shall contribute to Supplier's cooperative marketing development fund an amount equal to two percent (2%) of Distributor's Net Sales of Products during each calendar year, payable on or before January 31 of the following year.
Notify Tailspin Toys of change of control within 30 days

Northwind must notify Tailspin Toys in writing within 30 days after any Change of Control of Northwind; Tailspin Toys may then terminate by notice within 60 days after receiving it. Through June 30, 2029.
Distributor shall notify Supplier in writing within thirty (30) days after any Change of Control of Distributor.
Restrict Litware Inc software use to Northwind (no third parties)

Northwind must not let any Affiliate or third party access or use the Software (licensed for up to 250 Named Users), or sublicense, rent, lease, use it to serve third parties or reverse engineer it except as law permits. An uncured material breach (30 days) lets Litware Inc terminate the license.

Licensee shall not permit any Affiliate or other third party to access or use the Software. Licensee shall not sublicense, rent or lease the Software, use it to provide services to third parties, or reverse engineer it except to the extent permitted by applicable law.
Certify peak Named Users to Litware Inc (30 days after Nov 6)

Within 30 days after each November 6 anniversary, Northwind must deliver Litware Inc a true-up report certifying the maximum number of Named Users with access during the preceding Support Year; users above the licensed 250 are invoiced at $1,500 each plus pro-rated Support Fee.

Within thirty (30) days after each anniversary of the Effective Date, Licensee shall deliver to Licensor a true-up report certifying the maximum number of Named Users who had access to the Software at any time during the preceding Support Year.
Pay Litware Inc $84,000 annual support fee by November 6

Northwind must pay the $84,000 annual Support Fee on or before the first day of each Support Year (November 6), after Litware Inc invoices at least 45 days ahead. If support lapses, reinstatement costs the lapsed fees plus a 10% reinstatement fee.

Licensor shall issue its invoice for each Support Year at least forty-five (45) days before the start of that Support Year, and Licensee shall pay the Support Fee on or before the first day of that Support Year.
Send Litware Inc support non-renewal notice (60 days)

Support renews automatically each Support Year unless Northwind gives Litware Inc written notice of non-renewal at least 60 days before the next Support Year starts (by September 7, 2027 for the year starting November 6, 2027).
Support Services renew automatically for successive Support Years unless Licensee gives Licensor written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days before the start of the next Support Year.
Cooperate with Litware Inc license audit (15 business days' notice)

On at least 15 business days' written notice, at most once per 12 months, Litware Inc may audit Northwind's use of the Software, and Northwind must cooperate and give reasonable access to records and systems. Under-licensing is invoiced per Section 3.2, and Northwind bears the audit cost if it exceeds 10%.

Licensor may, no more than once in any twelve (12) month period and upon at least fifteen (15) business days' prior written notice, audit Licensee's use of the Software to verify compliance with this Agreement. Licensee shall cooperate with any such audit and provide reasonable access to relevant records and systems.
Litware Inc gives written audit notice
Proseware Inc: notify personal data breach within 48 hours

Proseware Inc must notify Northwind of any Personal Data Breach without undue delay and within 48 hours after becoming aware of it, describing its nature, the data subjects and records concerned, likely consequences and the measures taken or proposed.
Processor shall notify Controller of any Personal Data Breach without undue delay and in any event within forty-eight (48) hours after becoming aware of it.
Proseware Inc becomes aware of a Personal Data Breach
Proseware Inc: give 30 days' notice before a new sub-processor
Proseware Inc must give Northwind at least 30 days' prior written notice before engaging any new Sub-processor, identifying it, its location and the processing it will perform.
Processor shall give Controller at least thirty (30) days' prior written notice before engaging any new Sub-processor, identifying the Sub-processor, its location and the processing it will perform.
Proseware Inc plans to engage a new Sub-processor
Object to a new Proseware Inc sub-processor within 15 days

To object to a new Sub-processor on reasonable data protection grounds, Northwind must notify Proseware Inc in writing within 15 days after receiving Proseware Inc's notice; otherwise the Sub-processor is deemed approved.

If Controller objects to a new Sub-processor on reasonable data protection grounds, Controller shall notify Processor of its objection in writing within fifteen (15) days after receiving Processor's notice. If Controller does not object within that period, the new Sub-processor is deemed approved.
Northwind receives a new Sub-processor notice
Proseware Inc: deliver initial SOC 2 Type II report (30 days)
Proseware Inc must deliver Northwind a copy of its most recent SOC 2 Type II report no later than 30 days after the September 1, 2026 DPA Effective Date (by October 1, 2026).
Processor shall deliver to Controller a copy of its most recent SOC 2 Type II report no later than thirty (30) days after the DPA Effective Date.
Proseware Inc: deliver annual SOC 2 Type II report by October 1
After the initial report, Proseware Inc must deliver Northwind an updated SOC 2 Type II report on or before October 1 of each year while the DPA is in effect.
Thereafter, Processor shall deliver to Controller an updated SOC 2 Type II report on or before October 1 of each year during the term of this DPA.
Proseware Inc: return or delete personal data at termination
On termination of the Customer Analytics Services Agreement, personal data must be returned and deleted as set out in Section 11.4 of that agreement; this DPA does not state who acts, how or by when.
Return and deletion of Personal Data upon termination of the Services Agreement is governed by Section 11.4 of the Services Agreement.
Termination of the Customer Analytics Services Agreement

Pay Alpine Ski House monthly base rent by the 1st

Northwind must pay Monthly Base Rent of $42,750 in advance, without demand, deduction or offset, on or before the 1st of each month; rent not received within 5 days after its due date incurs a 5% late charge. Through September 30, 2027.
Tenant shall pay Monthly Base Rent in advance, without demand, deduction or offset, on or before the first (1st) day of each calendar month during the Term.
Restore Alpine Ski House security deposit within 10 days of demand

If Alpine Ski House applies any part of the $85,500 Security Deposit to cure a Northwind default, Northwind must restore the deposit to its full amount within 10 days after Alpine Ski House's written demand. Through September 30, 2027.
If Landlord applies any part of the Security Deposit to cure a default by Tenant, Tenant shall restore the Security Deposit to its full amount within ten (10) days after Landlord's written demand.
Alpine Ski House's written demand after applying the deposit
Notify Alpine Ski House of needed repairs within 10 days
Northwind must notify Alpine Ski House in writing of any condition in the Premises requiring repair by the Landlord within 10 days after discovering it. Through September 30, 2027.
Tenant shall notify Landlord in writing of any condition in the Premises requiring repair by Landlord within ten (10) days after Tenant discovers the condition.
Northwind discovers a condition needing Landlord repair
Deliver certificate of insurance to Alpine Ski House by January 15

Northwind must maintain commercial general liability insurance of at least $2,000,000 per occurrence and full-replacement property insurance throughout the Term, and deliver Alpine Ski House a certificate naming it as additional insured on or before January 15 each year. Through September 30, 2027.

Tenant shall maintain, throughout the Term, commercial general liability insurance with limits of not less than $2,000,000 per occurrence and property insurance covering Tenant's personal property at full replacement cost. Tenant shall deliver to Landlord a certificate of insurance evidencing the coverage required by this Section 5.1, naming Landlord as an additional insured, on or before January 15 of each calendar year during the Term.
Exercise Alpine Ski House lease renewal option by December 30, 2026

If not in default, Northwind may extend the lease once for 5 years at 95% of prevailing Bellevue market rent by written notice delivered between September 30 and December 30, 2026 (12 to 9 months before the September 30, 2027 Expiration Date); otherwise the option lapses. Through September 30, 2027.

Tenant may exercise the renewal option only by delivering written notice to Landlord no earlier than twelve (12) months and no later than nine (9) months before the Expiration Date. If Tenant does not deliver notice within that period, the renewal option lapses and is of no further force or effect.
Window opens 2026-09-30; notice before then is invalid.
Send Wide World Importers 6-month forecast by the 5th
On or before the 5th of each month, Northwind must give Wide World Importers a rolling 6-month non-binding forecast of its anticipated requirements for each Product. Through May 31, 2028.
On or before the fifth (5th) day of each calendar month, Buyer shall provide Supplier with a rolling six (6) month non-binding forecast of its anticipated requirements for each Product.
Wide World Importers: give 90 days' notice before discontinuing

Wide World Importers must give Northwind at least 90 days' prior written notice before discontinuing any Product and accept last-time-buy purchase orders for it submitted during that notice period. Through May 31, 2028.

Supplier shall give Buyer at least ninety (90) days' prior written notice before discontinuing any Product, and shall accept last-time-buy Purchase Orders for the discontinued Product submitted during that notice period.
Wide World Importers plans to discontinue a Product
Hold annual price review with Wide World Importers by October 31

Each year the parties must meet no later than October 31 to review Product pricing for the next calendar year; agreed changes take effect January 1 once documented in an updated Exhibit A signed by both. Through May 31, 2028.

Each year during the Term, the Parties shall meet no later than October 31 to review Product pricing for the following calendar year. Agreed price changes take effect on January 1 of the following year once documented in an updated Exhibit A signed by both Parties.
Pay Wide World Importers invoices within 45 days of receipt
Northwind must pay each undisputed shipment invoice, issued on delivery, within 45 days after receiving it. Through May 31, 2028.
Supplier will invoice each shipment upon delivery. Buyer shall pay each undisputed invoice within forty-five (45) days after receipt of the invoice.
Notify Wide World Importers of defects within 14 days of delivery

Northwind must notify Wide World Importers in writing of any Defect within 14 days after delivery of the affected Products, or they are deemed accepted (except latent Defects); the remedy is replacement or credit at Northwind's option. Through May 31, 2028.

Buyer shall notify Supplier in writing of any Defect within fourteen (14) days after delivery of the affected Products. Products for which Buyer gives no notice of Defect within that period are deemed accepted, except for latent Defects that could not reasonably have been discovered on inspection.
Pay Adventure Works Cycles quarterly rebate within 45 days

For each calendar quarter in which Net Purchases exceed $150,000, Northwind must pay Adventure Works Cycles a 3% rebate with a calculation statement within 45 days after quarter end; rebates for quarters ending by expiry stay payable after it. Through December 31, 2026.
Reseller shall pay each rebate earned under Section 3.1, together with a statement showing its calculation, within forty-five (45) days after the end of the applicable calendar quarter.
Give Adventure Works Cycles most-favored customer pricing

During the Term, Northwind must offer Adventure Works Cycles Product prices no less favorable than those it offers any Similarly Situated Customer, excluding one-time clearance pricing on discontinued Products and public-sector contract prices. Through December 31, 2026.
During the Term, Reseller shall offer Customer prices for the Products that are no less favorable than the prices Reseller offers to any Similarly Situated Customer.
Notify Adventure Works Cycles of better pricing within 30 days

If Northwind offers a Similarly Situated Customer more favorable prices for a Product, it must notify Adventure Works Cycles in writing within 30 days and extend those prices from the date they were first offered. Through December 31, 2026.

If Reseller offers more favorable prices for a Product to a Similarly Situated Customer, Reseller shall notify Customer in writing within thirty (30) days and extend the more favorable prices to Customer from the date they were first offered to the other customer.
Northwind offers better prices to a Similarly Situated Customer
Decide on Adventure Works Cycles renewal before December 31, 2026 expiry
The agreement expires on December 31, 2026 and does not renew automatically; any renewal or extension requires a written agreement signed by both parties. Through December 31, 2026.

This Agreement begins on January 1, 2024 and expires on December 31, 2026. This Agreement does not renew automatically, and any renewal or extension requires a written agreement signed by both Parties.
Fourth Coffee: deliver food-safety inspection certificate by March 1
Fourth Coffee must deliver Northwind a copy of its annual food-safety inspection certificate, issued by an accredited third-party inspector, by March 1 each year.
Supplier shall deliver to Customer a copy of its annual food-safety inspection certificate, issued by an accredited third-party inspector, by March 1 of each year.
Give Fourth Coffee 60 days' notice to terminate for convenience
Either party may end the agreement for convenience by giving the other at least 60 days' prior written notice.
Either Party may terminate this Agreement for convenience by giving the other Party at least sixty (60) days' prior written notice.

Pay Woodgrove Bank monthly interest on the 1st

Northwind must pay accrued interest on outstanding Advances (one-month Term SOFR plus 2.25%, actual/360) monthly in arrears on the 1st of each month; non-payment within 3 Business Days after the due date is an Event of Default. Through September 15, 2029.
The Borrower shall pay accrued interest on all outstanding Advances monthly in arrears on the first (1st) day of each calendar month.
Repay Woodgrove Bank advances at September 15, 2029 maturity
Northwind must repay all outstanding Advances, with accrued and unpaid interest, on the Maturity Date of September 15, 2029. Through September 15, 2029.
The Borrower shall repay all outstanding Advances, together with accrued and unpaid interest, on the Maturity Date.
Deliver Woodgrove Bank quarterly compliance certificate (45 days)

Within 45 days after each fiscal quarter end, starting with the quarter ending December 31, 2026, Northwind must deliver Woodgrove Bank a CFO-signed compliance certificate with unaudited consolidated quarterly financial statements showing compliance with the minimum Liquidity covenant. Through September 15, 2029.

Within forty-five (45) days after the end of each fiscal quarter of the Borrower, commencing with the fiscal quarter ending December 31, 2026, the Borrower shall deliver to the Bank a compliance certificate signed by its chief financial officer, together with unaudited consolidated financial statements for that quarter, demonstrating compliance with Section 4.1.
Deliver audited financial statements to Woodgrove Bank (120 days)

Within 120 days after each June 30 fiscal year end, starting with fiscal 2027 (due October 28, 2027), Northwind must deliver Woodgrove Bank audited consolidated financial statements with an unqualified opinion from an independent CPA firm. Through September 15, 2029.

Within one hundred twenty (120) days after the end of each fiscal year of the Borrower, which ends on June 30, commencing with the fiscal year ending June 30, 2027, the Borrower shall deliver to the Bank audited consolidated financial statements reported on without qualification by an independent certified public accounting firm.
Notify Woodgrove Bank of any default within 5 business days

Northwind must notify Woodgrove Bank in writing within 5 Business Days after any officer becomes aware of any Default or Event of Default, describing it and the action Northwind proposes to take. Through September 15, 2029.

The Borrower shall notify the Bank in writing within five (5) Business Days after any officer of the Borrower becomes aware of any Default or Event of Default, describing it and the action the Borrower proposes to take.
An officer becomes aware of a Default or Event of Default
Maintain $5,000,000 minimum liquidity with Woodgrove Bank

Northwind must keep at least $5,000,000 of unrestricted cash and cash equivalents in deposit accounts with Woodgrove Bank at all times, tested at each fiscal quarter end and reported in each compliance certificate; a breach is an Event of Default. Through September 15, 2029.
The Borrower shall maintain Liquidity of not less than $5,000,000 at all times. Compliance will be tested on the last day of each fiscal quarter and reported in each compliance certificate.
Deliver insurance endorsements to Woodgrove Bank (60 days)

Within 60 days after the September 15, 2026 Closing Date (by November 14, 2026), Northwind must deliver Woodgrove Bank lender's loss payable and additional insured endorsements, satisfactory to the Bank, under its property and general liability policies; failure continuing 15 days after Bank notice is an Event of Default. Through September 15, 2029.

Within sixty (60) days after the Closing Date, the Borrower shall deliver to the Bank lender's loss payable and additional insured endorsements, in form satisfactory to the Bank, under the Borrower's property and general liability insurance policies.
